about: Loadout templates (stream/loadouts.py, launcher/src-tauri/src/loadouts.rs): ready-made starter loadouts for the launcher's Mods & Addons › Loadouts and the site's /loadouts. Items are catalog ids of REVIEWED, published entries only (stream/upstream-addons.json) or leyline:addons; a pending id is never shown (loadouts.py drops it, test_loadouts.py fails on it). gfx is a launcher graphics preset (gfx.rs PRESETS). The launcher keeps the same list in ui/loadouts.js TEMPLATES (the test checks both match).

templates.name: Official realm
templates.line: The Leyline addons for game modes, golf and your Den, with balanced graphics.

templates.name: Quester
templates.line: Quest help on the map, gathering spots, item ids and stat values in tooltips.

templates.name: Raider
templates.line: A damage meter, cooldown and aura tracking, raid tools and gear checks.

templates.name: Tidy interface
templates.line: Movable action bars, one sorted bag, clearer unit frames, nameplates and minimap.

templates.line: The game's own settings turned all the way up. No files added.

templates.name: Old PC
templates.line: The game's own settings turned down for speed. No files added.
